svg.title: Views the agent draws
svg.desc: The agent sends a view in A2UI: "component": "OrderLine", a widget of your catalog; {"path": "/order/lines"}, data the screen lists; {"event": {"name": "place_order"}}, a method the screen lists. TandemView builds the view from your widgets: it draws only widgets of the catalog, follows the screen's data, and calls the method with its approval. The user sees the view: Your order, HDMI 2.1 cable, 2 m, 40 pcs; Voltra ProView 27Q, 12 pcs; Total 14 349.44 PLN; and a Place order button.
